# 09 Light

Full definition: [TAXONOMY.md](../../TAXONOMY.md), section 3.

**What belongs here.** Light washes over the cut: the in-between is luminance, glow or optical artefact.

**Test.** Does the frame get brighter, glowing or flared at the cut, with an optical (not flat) quality?

**Not here.** A flat fade to white is 02 Blend › Dip to Colour. A burn-edge wipe with no glow is 03 Wipe › Organic.

**Build.** Additive (screen / plus-lighter) layers, with the swap at peak brightness.

## Subfamilies

| Folder | What goes in it | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| [Flash](flash/) | A short burst of bright exposure with bloom. | white flash, camera flash |
| [Leak](leak/) | Soft coloured light drifts across. | light leak, prism leak |
| [Burn](burn/) | Film or paper burns through. | film burn, burn-through |
| [Flare](flare/) | A lens flare or light streak sweeps across. | anamorphic flare sweep |

## Transitions in this family

| Transition | Subfamily | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [Flash](flash/flash/) | Flash | A burst of overexposed light blows out the old scene and settles on the new one. |
| [Light Leak](leak/light-leak/) | Leak | Soft, warm light drifts across the frame and floods it, hiding the change, then fades off the new scene. |
| [Film Burn](burn/film-burn/) | Burn | Holes burn through the old scene with glowing edges until the frame is white-hot, then it cools to reveal the new scene. |
| [Flare Sweep](flare/flare-sweep/) | Flare | An anamorphic lens flare streaks across the frame and blooms over the cut. |
